title: Qualcomm layoffs: Who gets 4 months' salary and extra compensation under reported exit deal?
summary: Qualcomm's India layoffs could affect 1,000 employees. Reports suggest affected staff may get up to four months' salary as severance, plus additional payouts.
llm_summary: Qualcomm is planning to cut about 1,000 jobs at its Indian operations. Employees who are let go could receive a severance package worth up to four months’ salary, along with an extra payout that may include additional compensation or benefits. The move is part of a broader restructuring aimed at trimming costs and refocusing the company’s resources.
